result.title: The shikimate branch point feeding enterobactin in Escherichia coli
result.abstractText:
Background

The shikimate pathway feeds siderophore synthesis in Escherichia coli. We describe the enzymes at its branch point.

result.title: EntA and the dihydrodiol step in Escherichia coli
result.abstractText: Here we show that EntA converts dihydrodiol to dihydroxybenzoate in Escherichia coli. The diol is then quickly turned into the benzoate.
